svg.title: Draw it: one sentence, one row, and what fell out
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw two sentences that mean opposite things together with the single identical row of counts they both produce, list the three things the row threw away which are word order, negation and what-modifies-what, and write the sparsity as 363 stored of 5,520 cells, which is 93.4 per cent empty.
svg.text: Draw it: one sentence, one row, and what fell out
1. two sentences that mean OPPOSITE things, and the one identical row they both give
2. the three things the row threw away: word order, negation, what-modifies-what
3. the sparsity: 363 stored of 5,520 cells = 93.4% empty
